title: Rational Sparse Autoencoder
abstract: arXiv:2606.14990v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are standard tools for mechanistic interpretability, but current SAE families are constrained by fixed encoder nonlinearities such as ReLU, JumpReLU, and TopK. This hard-codes a particular sparsity mechanism into the model and can distort the reconstruction-versus-sparsity trade-off. We introduce the Rational Sparse Autoencoder (RSAE), which replaces the fixed encoder activation with a trainable rational function. The design is motivated by a reconstruction advantage that we prove for RSAE at matched expected sparsity, with guaranteed non-inferiority to ReLU and, under stated assumptions, provable improvements over JumpReLU and TopK. The model is then implemented through a two-stage pipeline: an initialization procedure that copies the pre-trained baseline SAE weights and calibrates the scale parameters along with the rational coefficients; followed by a fine-tuning step under a sparsity-regularized r

translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）是机制可解释性研究的标准工具，但当前的 SAE 家族受到固定编码器非线性激活函数（如 ReLU、JumpReLU 和 TopK）的约束。这种做法将特定的稀疏机制硬编码进模型，并可能扭曲重构与稀疏性之间的权衡。我们提出了有理稀疏自编码器（RSAE），它用一个可训练的有理函数取代固定的编码器激活函数。该设计的动机源于我们在匹配期望稀疏度下为 RSAE 证明的重构优势：保证不劣于 ReLU，并且在给定假设下，可证明优于 JumpReLU 和 TopK。该模型通过两阶段流水线实现：首先是一个初始化过程，复制预训练的基线 SAE 权重，并对尺度参数和有理系数进行校准；随后在稀疏正则化的（微调步骤中进行优化，原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出有理稀疏自编码器（RSAE），用可训练的有理函数取代固定的编码器激活函数，在匹配期望稀疏度下从理论上保证不劣于 ReLU，并在给定假设下可证明优于 JumpReLU 和 TopK。
en_tdlr: The Rational Sparse Autoencoder (RSAE) replaces fixed encoder activations (ReLU/JumpReLU/TopK) with a trainable rational function, provably non-inferior to ReLU and, under stated assumptions, better than JumpReLU and TopK at matched expected sparsity.
